Let me be very clear: these shoes are NOT cheap, yet the service feels like a scam operation. When you charge high prices, the bare minimum is honesty and reliability, both of which this brand completely lacks.

This experience has been exhausting and disappointing. I feel cheated and ignored as a customer.
DO NOT BUY FROM THEM Ira Solesunless you enjoy being misled, strung along, and treated like your time and money mean nothing.

Extremely disappointing and frustrating experience.

I placed an order (#55695) on 21st March and made full payment. Even after several weeks, the product has not been delivered and there has been no clear or consistent update regarding the status.

Initially, I was given repeated assurances that the order would be dispatched “within a week.” However these promises were never fulfilled. Every follow up resulted in another assurance but no actual progress.

What is more concerning is the complete lack of response recently. Messages on WhatsApp and Instagram are being ignored despite the team being active online and regularly posting updates. Calls are also not being answered.

This is not just a delay.. it reflects a serious lack of accountability and professionalism after taking payment from a customer.

As a customer this has been a very stressful and disappointing experience. It should not require this level of follow up just to receive a basic update or response.

I have now escalated this issue through consumer complaint channels due to the absence of any proper resolution.

I would strongly advise others to be cautious before placing an order here until there is a clear improvement in communication and reliability.

featured_reviews.review_text:
If you’re into sneakers and streetwear, VegNonVeg Mumbai is one of the best places to shop. Located in Bandra West, the store offers a great selection of Nike, Adidas, Puma, New Balance, and ASICS sneakers, including exclusive collaborations and limited editions that are hard to find elsewhere.

The moment you walk in, you’ll notice the modern, minimalist aesthetic of the store. Sneakers are displayed in a way that makes them feel like collector’s pieces rather than just products. The layout is clean, spacious, and well-organized, making it easy to browse and appreciate every pair.

Their sneaker collection is impressive, featuring everything from Air Jordans and Dunks to Adidas Sambas and ASICS GEL series. Whether you’re into performance sneakers or casual lifestyle pairs, they have a mix of both. However, since they stock a lot of high-demand releases, sizes sell out quickly—so if you’re looking for a specific pair, it’s best to check their website or call ahead.

Apart from sneakers, they also have a great streetwear collection, including graphic tees, hoodies, caps, and accessories that align with global sneaker culture. Their in-house VegNonVeg brand has some cool designs that you won’t find elsewhere.

The customer service is excellent—the staff is friendly, knowledgeable, and genuinely passionate about sneakers. They are happy to help with sizing, styling tips, and sneaker recommendations.

Pricing is on the higher side, but considering the exclusivity of the products, it’s understandable. If you’re into rare sneakers and premium streetwear, this place is definitely worth visiting.

ZERO Star – Buyer Beware: Professional Branding, Poor Customer Support

I am writing this review to share my experience and help other customers make an informed decision before placing an order with Downtown.

I placed an online order on 22 May 2026 (Order No: DT18764OD) and received an order confirmation stating that my order was being prepared for shipment. Based on the company's branding, online presence, and reputation, I expected a smooth and professional experience. Unfortunately, that has not been the case.

Since placing the order, I have repeatedly tried to obtain updates and assistance regarding my purchase. Multiple emails have either gone unanswered or have not resulted in any meaningful resolution. As a paying customer, being left without proper communication is both frustrating and disappointing.

To understand what was happening, I even had a friend personally visit the Mumbai showroom. The staff there informed us that they could not assist with online orders because they operate as a franchise location. They directed us to contact the Delhi team instead.

The problem is that there appears to be no effective customer support system for online buyers. There is no readily available responsive contact number, and emails remain unanswered. As a customer, I have been left going back and forth between different entities without anyone taking ownership of the issue.

What concerns me most is the gap between the company's premium image and the actual customer experience. The website, social media presence, celebrity endorsements, and marketing create a strong impression of credibility and professionalism. However, customer service and accountability after payment are what truly define a business.

My advice to potential customers is simple: do not make your decision based solely on Instagram posts, celebrity associations, influencer promotions, or online branding. Judge a business by how it responds when a customer needs help after making a payment.

A legitimate and customer-focused business should:
• Respond to emails promptly.
• Provide accessible customer support.
• Offer transparent order updates.
• Take responsibility for online purchases.
• Resolve customer concerns professionally.

Unfortunately, my experience has not reflected these basic expectations.

I am still willing to update this review if Downtown responds, provides a proper explanation, and resolves the issue. Until then, I cannot recommend purchasing from them based on my experience.

Buyer Beware: Professional branding and celebrity marketing may create trust, but customer support, communication, and accountability are what truly matter when things go wrong.

Before placing an order, I strongly recommend verifying that there is a responsive support system in place and reading recent customer experiences carefully.

I hope this review helps other customers avoid the frustration and uncertainty that I have experienced.

Converse is pure GOLD! I’ve been in love with this brand for over a decade now, and honestly, words can’t fully do justice to how amazing it feels to wear these shoes. They’re incredibly comfortable, and Converse somehow keeps leveling up the style game too.

I had been waiting for a Converse store in Mumbai for the longest time, and a late-night random search finally proved me right. The store, located in the heart of Khar, is hard to miss. And not to be dramatic, but walking in genuinely felt like entering a candy store.

The space is neat, clean, compact, and thoughtfully laid out with just the right things in the right places. But more importantly, the people there are absolute gems.

I only made the trip because Yuri was kind enough to patiently respond to all my queries over text. And Gulzar — what an absolute pleasure it was interacting with you! His product knowledge, explanations, patience, and suggestions were spot on. I genuinely had the best time chatting about Converse and its history with him. In fact, the conversation was so enriching that I completely forgot to click photos of the store but I’ll definitely be back soon to upload the pair I picked up :)

Everything about the people, the store, and the brand makes the visit worth it. And of course… buy the shoes. The experience itself is priceless :)

featured_reviews.name: Suhana Khanna
featured_reviews.review_text:
I had a wonderful experience at the Converse store thanks to Gulzar. From the moment I walked in, he was incredibly welcoming, attentive, and genuinely helpful. He took the time to understand what I was looking for and patiently showed me multiple options, offering thoughtful suggestions without being pushy.
What really stood out was his knowledge about the products and his willingness to go the extra mile to make sure I found exactly what I wanted. Gulzar made the entire shopping experience smooth, enjoyable, and completely stress-free.
It’s rare to come across customer service that feels this genuine and attentive. Gulzar’s professionalism, friendliness, and dedication truly reflect positively on the store. I would definitely look forward to visiting again because of the excellent service he provided.
